summary: Confirmed DONE by 60633eff3 (#710). detectRepository now runs one combined `git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree --show-toplevel --git-common-dir` (nonzero exit or a non-'true' first line means not a repository). The VcsDriverRegistry keeps positive detections for 2 minutes and revalidates each read with a stat of <root>/.git (dev:ino:kind); negative results keep the old 2 s TTL. The real-git contract harness and a registry test cover the combined command and .git-identity revalidation. No consumer reads handle.repository.rootPath/metadataPath/freshness (only kind and driver, run against input.cwd), so a stale positive entry can only matter if the folder stops being a repository, and removing the root .git catches that. That makes the auditor's 'intermediate git init' gap functionally moot. Two minor issues remain. (1) The nested-.git check can defeat the cache entirely in a rare layout. (2) The proposal's explicit invalidation after `git init` was not implemented. Negative entries are never revalidated, so a ≤2 s stale 'not a repository' can still be read right after init. This race already existed and is not a regression.

evidence.note: detectRepository: a single gitCommand with the combined rev-parse, allowNonZeroExit, READ_ONLY_GIT_ENV (GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0).
parseDetectRepositoryOutput returns null on a nonzero exit, a first line other than 'true', or an empty toplevel. This covers bare repositories and cwd inside .git, where --show-toplevel exits 128.
NEGATIVE_DETECTION_CACHE_TTL is 2 s and POSITIVE_DETECTION_CACHE_TTL is 2 min.
The cache stores gitPathIdentity, and detect() restats <root>/.git on every read. When cwd differs from rootPath it also stats <cwd>/.git and invalidates if that differs from the root's identity.
Test that a re-initialized .git and a nested git init both cause redetection.
The real-driver contract tests detection outside a repo, at the root and in a nested directory.

Every consumer (also WorkspaceEntries.ts:550, CheckpointStore.ts:58, ForgejoApi.ts:902, BitbucketApi.ts:862, SourceControlProviderRegistry.ts:684) uses only handle.kind and handle.driver with input.cwd. The cached rootPath and metadataPath are never read.
resolveKind still walks the ancestors with fs.exists on every detect. These are cheap stats, not spawns.

initializeGitForProject runs git init and then ensureProjectMainWorktree -> gitWorkflow.localStatus -> registry.detect. A negative entry cached for workspaceRoot in the prior 2 s returns isRepo=false, which leads to 'The initialized repository is unavailable.' No invalidation happens after init (VcsProvisioningService.ts:41-47; gitRpc.ts:496 refreshGitStatus has the same window).

fixDefects: Minor, and none is a regression in the targeted cost. (1) Cache-defeating loop: VcsDriverRegistry.ts:172-181 compares <cwd>/.git with the root's .git identity. If cwd is a subdirectory whose .git exists but which git does not treat as its own root, the two always differ. Examples are an empty or invalid .git directory, which git discovery skips before moving to the parent. In that case every detect() invalidates and spawns rev-parse again, so that cwd never gets a cache hit (one spawn per call, worse than the old 2 s TTL). The layout is rare. (2) The proposal's 'invalidate explicitly on project init' was not implemented, and negative entries are never revalidated. After VcsProvisioningService.initRepository, worktreeOperations.ts:306 (ensureProjectMainWorktree via localStatus) and gitRpc.ts:496 (refreshGitStatus) can read a stale negative cached within the prior 2 s. In the chat-promotion flow (chatPromotion.ts:1236 -> initializeGitForProject), a client status subscription on the new root shortly before init could make init report 'The initialized repository is unavailable.' This race already existed with the old uniform 2 s TTL. The code path is verified; how often the timing occurs is not. (3) The auditor's intermediate-directory git-init gap has no functional effect, because no consumer reads the cached rootPath.
implementationSketch: Optional cleanup, low priority. (a) In VcsDriverRegistry, record a cwdGitIdentity in CachedDetection (stat of <cwd>/.git at load time, null if absent, skipped when cwd resolves to rootPath). In detect(), compare the current <cwd>/.git identity against that stored value instead of against the root identity. This fixes the empty/invalid nested .git loop and still catches a new nested git init. Add a registry test that creates an empty <root>/nested/.git directory with the fake process still reporting the outer root, and assert that repeated detects spawn once. (b) Add `invalidate(cwd)` to VcsDriverRegistryShape: Cache.invalidate for keys `auto\0cwd` and `git\0cwd`, plus realpath(cwd) to match VcsStatusBroadcaster.normalizeCwd. Call it in VcsProvisioningService.initRepository after a successful driver.initRepository, and wherever Ryco creates or removes worktrees if desired. Add a test that detects a non-repo folder (negative), runs initRepository, and checks that detect immediately returns a handle. Also consider replacing GitVcsDriverCore.ts:1290-1298 resolveGitCommonDir (an extra rev-parse spawn per remote-status refresh) with the metadataPath already in the cached detection. That is a separate, small saving.
decisionReason: Server-internal caching only. No auth, E2EE, Hub protocol or hosted lifecycle impact.
